params.name: add_storages
params.description: Configure VM and CT storage using the new pool. Defaults to false for replicated pools and to true for erasure-coded pools (since EC pools are typically only useful when wired up to storage).

params.name: crush_rule
params.description: The rule to use for mapping object placement in the cluster.

params.name: erasure-coding
params.description: Create an erasure coded pool for RBD with an accompaning replicated pool for metadata storage. With EC, the common ceph options 'size', 'min_size' and 'crush_rule' parameters will be applied to the metadata pool.

device-class.description: CRUSH device class. Will create an erasure coded pool plus a replicated pool for metadata.

failure-domain.description: CRUSH failure domain. Default is 'host'. Will create an erasure coded pool plus a replicated pool for metadata.

k.description: Number of data chunks. Will create an erasure coded pool plus a replicated pool for metadata.

m.description: Number of coding chunks. Will create an erasure coded pool plus a replicated pool for metadata.

profile.description: Override the erasure code (EC) profile to use. Will create an erasure coded pool plus a replicated pool for metadata.

params.name: min_size
params.description: Minimum number of replicas per object

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the pool. It must be unique.

params.name: pg_autoscale_mode
params.description: The automatic PG scaling mode of the pool.

params.name: target_size
params.description: The estimated target size of the pool for the PG autoscaler.

params.name: target_size_ratio
params.description: The estimated target ratio of the pool for the PG autoscaler.
